nodes.label: Dual-Role User System
nodes.description: App serves two user roles: (1) Patients (mothers) with full educational and journaling features, (2) Nurses who monitor patients and manage clinical data.

nodes.label: App Visual Assets
nodes.description: Brand assets: main icon, screen-specific logos (login, register, activate, forgot-reset), and feature icons (modules, quiz, pre-test, post-test, references, video).

nodes.label: Multi-Platform Flutter Build
nodes.description: Built for Android (primary), iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and Web via Flutter's multi-platform toolchain.

nodes.label: Stunting Education Mission
nodes.description: Core app purpose: educate Indonesian mothers about stunting prevention, maternal nutrition, and infant health through structured modules, assessments, and journaling.

nodes.label: Health Journaling System
nodes.description: Dual journaling: LogbookPage for mother's daily health records + BabyJournalPage for infant growth tracking.

nodes.label: Firebase Integration
nodes.description: Firebase Core and Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications to mothers and nurses.

nodes.label: Generasi Emas App
nodes.description: Flutter mobile app for maternal health education and stunting prevention (Partisipasi Ibu & Edukasi Stunting). Targets Indonesian mothers (patients) and healthcare nurses.

nodes.label: Project Dependencies
nodes.description: Key packages: http (API), webview_flutter, video_player+chewie, firebase_core+messaging, flutter_local_notifications, shared_preferences, connectivity_plus, flutter_localization

nodes.label: Pre/Post Test Assessment System
nodes.description: Knowledge measurement system: PretestPage before program → educational modules → PosttestPage to measure knowledge gain about stunting prevention.

nodes.label: Common Widgets
nodes.description: Shared UI widgets used across multiple pages.
